name: popsicle
headline: Mautic-Theme: Modern Forms & Popups
short_description: A basic theme for Mautic, the open-source marketing automation suite. It includes styling of forms and pop-up items. Basic styling of emails and pages is included to be completed at a later stage.
author: Custonext

sections.overview:
Mautic-theme is a design template for Mautic, the open-source marketing automation platform, that upgrades the default appearance of forms and popup items. The theme includes modern styling for four popup types—slide-in, modal, notification bar, and full-page—allowing marketers to customize text and button colors in basic mode or via custom HTML and the editor. Basic styling for emails and pages is included as a foundation for further customization. Users install the theme by downloading the ZIP file and setting it as default in Mautic's configuration settings, then adjust colors and content to match their brand.
Improving visual appearance of Mautic popup campaigns without coding
Creating branded lead capture forms with consistent styling
Deploying modern notification bars and slide-in popups for visitor engagement
Customizing modal popups with brand colors and messaging
A modern, responsive Mautic theme designed for GreenTech Solutions, a renewable energy company. The theme incorporates a clean, eco-friendly color scheme and a professional font family to align with the brand's identity.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/Custonext/mautic-theme`
sections.usage:
```
Create a Mautic theme for [COMPANY], a [INDUSTRY] business. The theme should include styling for forms, pop-up items, and basic styling for emails and pages. Use [COLOR_SCHEME] and [FONT_FAMILY] as the primary design elements. Ensure the theme is responsive and mobile-friendly.
```
